name: Ramesses IV
response:
Ramesses IV was a Pharaoh of Egypt, who reigned for 8 years. He was the son of Amenemhat III, and the father of Siptah. His mother was Khenemet-kuy. He is called the 'lame prince' by some historians, due to his small stature, which he shares with the boy pharaoh Siptah.

His reign was one of decline and collapse, his son, Siptah, being a child of 10 when he became pharaoh, and reigned for only 4 years, leaving a number of unfinished monuments and sculptures.
